title: Atlas consent workflow
text: Atlas Clinic records consent in form AC-17. A certified interpreter is required when the patient requests translated consent.

title: Beacon research visits
text: The synthetic Beacon study uses protocol BT-204. Follow-up research visits occur every six weeks.

title: Cedar specimen storage
text: Cedar Laboratory stores study specimens at minus 80 degrees Celsius. Retention lasts seven years after study closure.

title: Delta imaging arrival
text: Delta Imaging asks patients to arrive 20 minutes before a scheduled scan. Registration occurs at desk D4.

title: Elm portal messages
text: Elm Health routes nonurgent portal messages to the care team within 72 hours. Emergency messages are not accepted through the portal.

title: Fir medication reconciliation
text: Fir Practice performs medication reconciliation at every admission and discharge. The assigned nurse records completion.

title: Grove image exchange
text: Grove Hospital exchanges diagnostic images in DICOM format. Temporary transfer links expire after 30 days.

title: Harbor records request
text: Harbor Medical processes complete records requests within 15 business days. Requests are tracked with prefix HRR.

title: Iris privacy training
text: Iris Network requires privacy training every 12 months. Completion is stored in the learning portal.

title: Jade device calibration
text: Jade Clinic calibrates monitoring devices each quarter. Failed devices are labeled out of service.

title: Kestrel callback queue
text: Kestrel Pediatrics assigns callback tickets a four-digit sequence. Open tickets are reviewed at 16:00.

title: Lotus archive export
text: Lotus Research exports deidentified records as encrypted CSV files. Export keys rotate every 90 days.
